# Tooling and generated files

## Tools (`tools/`)

- `localize.py`: derives `en-001`, `en-gb`, and `en-us` from `en-gb-oxendict`.
- `gen_nav.py`: writes the README table of contents, each English locale's
  home page, contents page, and subject index (topic 9.7). `just nav`.
- `gen_locale_peer_ids.py`: assigns and writes `.locale-peer-id` sidecars for
  the four English locales.
- `gen_llms.py`: writes the site's `llms.txt` and `llms.json` from the locale
  directories and the served-locale list. `just llms`.
- `section_names.py`: reads `spec/section-names.json`.
- `stats.py`: the Markdown stats report. `just stats`.

## Justfile tasks

`just test` (the validation suite), `just nav`, `just llms`, `just check`
(nav, llms, test), `just emdash`, `just spell`, `just stats`.

## What `just test` enforces

`tests/validate.py` checks the four English locales for chapter count and
template sections, style rules, links, structure against `spec/structure.md`,
and peer-id sidecars. It also checks that `llms.txt` and `llms.json` are
current and that `skills/` and `.claude/skills/` are identical. It does not
check the translated locales' prose.

## Never hand-edit these (the next run overwrites them)

- `README.md`, each English locale's `index.md` and
  `front-matter/table-of-contents.md`, and each English locale's `09-07`
  index: generated by `gen_nav.py`.
- `en-001`, `en-gb`, `en-us`: derived by `localize.py`.
- `software-engineering-metrics.github.io/src/content/` and
  `src/lib/manifest*`: generated from `locales/` by `pnpm content`.
- `software-engineering-metrics.github.io/static/llms.txt` and `llms.json`:
  generated by `gen_llms.py`.

## Agent skills

`skills/` holds the canonical skills: `software-engineering-metrics-skill`
(for readers applying the book) and `software-engineering-metrics-maintainer-skill`
(for contributors). After editing one, copy it over the matching file in
`.claude/skills/`; the tests fail if the two differ.

## Instruction files

`CLAUDE.md` is a one-line pointer to `AGENTS.md`. Keep `AGENTS.md`, every file
in `AGENTS/`, and the site's own `AGENTS.md` well under 40 KB each.
